subject: Half-hour walkthrough — pick a time and quick prep items
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@oxbridgehealth.com>, Bryan Cole <bryan.cole@oxbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Half-hour walkthrough — pick a time and quick prep items

Alex / Bryan — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next step: a half-hour product walkthrough (demo + 10-minute Q&A) to show how Redwood Inference handles low-latency inference, privacy controls, and deployment modes relevant to Oxbridge.

What I need from you: pick one of the two windows below that works best for your team and confirm who will attend (we recommend 2–3 stakeholders: product/PM + infra/ops + security/comp).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Wed, Nov 18, 10:00–10:30am PST
- Option B: Thu, Nov 19, 3:00–3:30pm PST

If neither works, send two times that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ve attached a one-page pre-demo checklist and a high-level architecture diagram so your infra lead can scan ahead (attachments below).

Suggested attendees:
- Alex Rivera — Product (you)
- Bryan Cole — Infrastructure/Cloud (ops)
- (optional) Security or Compliance lead if you want to cover SOC2/data residency specifics

Prep notes (short):
- We’ll do a live run of a 512-token generation with your expected concurrency pattern — if you can share a representative qps/sequence length that’d be helpful.
- If you have any network/IP allowlist requirements, flag them now so we can add to the invite.

Attachments (stubs): pre-demo-checklist.pdf (1p, checklist) — high-level-architecture.png (diagram, 800x600)

Thanks — I’ll hold both windows tentatively until I hear from you.

Best,
Irene
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@oxbridgehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Bryan Cole <bryan.cole@oxbridgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Half-hour walkthrough — pick a time and quick prep items

Irene — thanks for the recap and the materials. Option B (Thu, Nov 19, 3:00–3:30pm PST) works best for our group. I’ll add Bryan (ops) and request a short calendar invite.

Two quick questions from our side before the session:
1) Data residency — do you support keeping inference-only logs in our VPC for auditability, or is that only available on Private deployments?
2) SOC2 evidence — we’ll want to surface what proofs you can provide. If you have a one-page SOC2 summary, can you attach it?

We’ll confirm final attendee names tomorrow.

—Alex
Product Manager, Oxbridge Health

- Data residency: for hosted customers we support token-level obfuscation and can push request logs to your VPC via Private Connect; full customer-managed data retention and on-prem logs are available with Private deployments. I’ll bring Neha (security/compliance) to address the SOC2 variants you mentioned.

- 0–10m: product overview + matching to your use cases (product)

- 22–30m: Q&A and next steps (mutual action items)
